title: Tokamak-SI: Interpreting Tokamak Discharges with Labeled Catalogs
abstract: arXiv:2610.32264v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Finding which phenomena occur in a tokamak discharge, and when, is often a manual task. Previous efforts at labeling events have been task-specific, each with its own corpus of data. We introduce Tokamak-SI, which combines the labels and labeling methods of many earlier studies into a single scalable, time-aligned, and categorical dataset covering observations from confinement, detachment, alfven eigenmodes (AE), edge localized modes (ELM), sawtooth, tearing modes (TM), and resistive wall modes in DIII-D tokamak. Models based on this, which can extend the labels to new shots, match or beat earlier detectors on its labels, including for AE, ELM, and TM detection. Tokamak-SI is intended to enable task-specific benchmarking, physics-searchable archives, and direct identification of key events during an experiment.

translated_title: 托卡马克-SI：利用标记目录解读托卡马克放电
translated_abstract: 确定托卡马克放电中发生了哪些现象以及何时发生，通常是一项人工任务。以往对事件进行标记的工作都是针对特定任务的，每个工作都有自己独立的数据语料库。我们提出了Tokamak-SI，它将许多早期研究的标签和标记方法整合成一个单一的可扩展、时间对齐且分类化的数据集，涵盖DIII-D托卡马克中约束、脱靶、阿尔芬本征模（AE）、边缘局域模（ELM）、锯齿、撕裂模（TM）和电阻壁模等现象的观测数据。基于该数据集训练的模型能够将标签扩展到新的放电炮次，在AE、ELM和TM检测等标签任务上达到或超越早期的探测器。Tokamak-SI旨在支持特定任务的基准测试、物理可搜索的实验档案，以及在实验过程中直接识别关键事件。
tldr: Tokamak-SI将DIII-D托卡马克多种物理现象的标记和标记方法整合为统一、可扩展、时间对齐的数据集，基于它的模型在AE、ELM和TM检测等任务上达到或超越早期探测器。
en_tdlr: Tokamak-SI unifies labels and labeling methods from many prior tokamak studies into a single scalable, time-aligned, categorical dataset for DIII-D, enabling models that match or beat earlier detectors for AE, ELM, and TM detection.
